-- message --
sync: keep going when one supplier fails
-- expect --
medium+
-- base/internal/sync/sync.go --
package sync

func All(suppliers []Supplier) error {
	for _, s := range suppliers {
		if err := s.Pull(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
-- head/internal/sync/sync.go --
package sync

func All(suppliers []Supplier) error {
	for _, s := range suppliers {
		_ = s.Pull()
	}
	return nil
}
